function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values (86 rows total), meaning some patients appear more than once. The data dictionary states that `sample_seq` is the assay run number and that the row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for that patient.", "implication": "We must deduplicate on `patient_id` by keeping only the row with the highest `sample_seq` per patient. Failure to do so will double-count re-tested patients and bias the response rate estimate. This is critical because the population is defined as 'all patients' after deduplication, so we must apply this step before computing any proportions."}
function.name: note_finding
